### EMP-00000001-0037
Case EMP-00000001-0037 concerns Diya Joshi, assigned to Facilities in Vadodara. The case category is configuration mismatch. Current workflow state: pending. The People Operations reviewer opened the case on 4 August 2026 and linked it to an internal record.
The employee's manager was asked to confirm the business context, but the manager's confirmation was not treated as a substitute for any specialist approval. The record distinguishes a request from its approved state and approved state from the resulting payroll, attendance, access, or asset update.
Relevant supporting evidence was stored in the approved repository. Personal credentials were never requested. Where a regional rule was relevant, the employee's assigned location was used rather than the location of a temporary visit.
The case is intentionally transaction-specific. Its reference, owner, dates and current state should not be copied to another employee simply because the same category appears there.
